note
	description: "Scratch whole-file benchmark using the unchanged dual-catalog parser adapters."

class
	DC_FILE_BENCHMARK_ROOT

inherit
	DC_CATALOG_FIXTURE

create
	make

feature {NONE} -- Command line

	make
		local
			l_arguments: ARGUMENTS_32
			l_path: detachable STRING_32
			i, l_iterations: INTEGER
			l_has_iterations, l_invalid: BOOLEAN
		do
			create l_arguments
			from i := 1 until i > l_arguments.argument_count or l_invalid loop
				if l_arguments.argument (i).same_string ("--iterations") and not l_has_iterations and then i < l_arguments.argument_count and then l_arguments.argument (i + 1).is_integer then
					l_iterations := l_arguments.argument (i + 1).to_integer
					l_has_iterations := True
					i := i + 2
				elseif l_arguments.argument (i).same_string ("--file") and l_path = Void and then i < l_arguments.argument_count and then not l_arguments.argument (i + 1).is_empty then
					l_path := l_arguments.argument (i + 1).twin
					i := i + 2
				else
					l_invalid := True
				end
			end
			if l_invalid or not l_has_iterations or l_iterations <= 0 then
				io.error.put_string ("usage: --iterations POSITIVE_INTEGER [--file PATH]%N")
				exit_with_code (2)
			elseif attached l_path as l_file_path then
				if attached raw_file_bytes (l_file_path) as l_document then
					benchmark (l_document, l_iterations)
				else
					io.error.put_string ("benchmark cannot read complete XML file%N")
					exit_with_code (2)
				end
			elseif catalog.count = 2611 then
				benchmark (catalog, l_iterations)
			else
				io.error.put_string ("unexpected catalog fixture length%N")
				exit_with_code (2)
			end
		end

	benchmark (a_document: STRING_8; a_iterations: INTEGER)
			-- Prepare one backend and repeatedly parse the same immutable bytes.
		local
			l_backend: DC_BACKEND
			i: INTEGER
			l_ok: BOOLEAN
		do
			create l_backend.make (False)
			from i := 0; l_ok := True until i = a_iterations or not l_ok loop
				l_ok := l_backend.parse (a_document)
				if l_ok then i := i + 1 end
			end
			if l_ok and i = a_iterations then
				l_backend.close
				io.put_string ("xpact benchmark harness parsed " + i.out + " documents.%N")
			else
				io.error.put_string ("file benchmark failed after " + i.out + " documents: " + l_backend.last_error + "%N")
				l_backend.close
				exit_with_code (1)
			end
		end

	raw_file_bytes (a_path: READABLE_STRING_GENERAL): detachable STRING_8
			-- Read original bytes once; preserve BOMs, encodings and line endings.
		local
			l_file: RAW_FILE
			l_expected_count: INTEGER
		do
			create l_file.make_with_name (a_path)
			if l_file.exists and then l_file.is_plain and then l_file.is_readable then
				l_file.open_read
				l_expected_count := l_file.count
				create Result.make (l_expected_count)
				from until Result.count >= l_expected_count or else l_file.end_of_file loop
					l_file.read_stream (65536)
					Result.append (l_file.last_string)
				end
				l_file.close
				if Result.count /= l_expected_count then Result := Void end
			end
		rescue
			io.error.put_string ("benchmark file read failed%N")
			exit_with_code (2)
		end

	exit_with_code (a_code: INTEGER)
		local
			l_exceptions: EXCEPTIONS
		do
			create l_exceptions
			l_exceptions.die (a_code)
		end

end

"""Single-document acceptance and error-protocol checks; no throughput timings."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess


def sha256(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--implementation", required=True,
                        choices=("xpact", "xpact-core", "xpact-baseline"))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    scratch = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    repo = scratch.parents[2]
    manifest_path = scratch / (args.implementation + "-Finalized-build.json")
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    executable = Path(manifest["executable"])
    if sha256(executable) != manifest["executable_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Executable changed after build")
    core = repo / "build/dependencies/xpact-core/6c017fb5b6e04fd0ae401bc54bb3c6a3c3bd6676"
    files = [
        ("catalog", None),
        ("text", repo / "build/parser-profile-20261025/fixtures/text.xml"),
        ("attributes", repo / "build/parser-profile-20261025/fixtures/attributes.xml"),
        ("pubmed", repo / "build/large-xml-corpus/pubmed26n1380-first-records-512k.xml"),
        ("unicode", core / "tools/data/xmlns-mandarin-stylesheet.xsl"),
        ("legislation", core / "tools/data/DT-Legislation.xml"),
    ]
    work = scratch / "smoke" / args.implementation
    work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    rows = []
    for name, path in files:
        command = [str(executable), "--iterations", "1"]
        row = {"name": name, "path": str(path) if path else None}
        if path:
            row.update(bytes=path.stat().st_size, sha256=sha256(path))
            command += ["--file", str(path)]
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=work, capture_output=True, timeout=30)
            row.update(exit_code=result.returncode,
                       stdout=result.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace"),
                       stderr=result.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace"))
            row["accepted"] = (result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout.strip()
                               == b"xpact benchmark harness parsed 1 documents.")
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            row.update(exit_code=None, accepted=False, status="timeout")
        if path and sha256(path) != row["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Input changed during smoke: " + str(path))
        rows.append(row)
        print(name, row["accepted"], row.get("exit_code"), flush=True)
    protocol = []
    for name, arguments in [
        ("missing-iterations", []),
        ("zero-iterations", ["--iterations", "0"]),
        ("missing-file", ["--iterations", "1", "--file", str(work / "does-not-exist.xml")]),
    ]:
        result = subprocess.run([str(executable)] + arguments, cwd=work,
                                capture_output=True, timeout=10)
        protocol.append({"name": name, "exit_code": result.returncode,
                         "passed": result.returncode == 2,
                         "stdout": result.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace"),
                         "stderr": result.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace")})
    negative = []
    for name, document in [("mismatched", b"<root></other>"), ("empty", b"")]:
        path = work / (name + ".xml")
        path.write_bytes(document)
        result = subprocess.run([str(executable), "--iterations", "1", "--file", str(path)],
                                cwd=work, capture_output=True, timeout=10)
        negative.append({"name": name, "exit_code": result.returncode,
                         "passed": result.returncode == 1,
                         "stdout": result.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace"),
                         "stderr": result.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace")})
    report = {
        "status": "single-document-smoke-only", "implementation": args.implementation,
        "build_manifest": str(manifest_path), "exe_sha256": manifest["executable_sha256"],
        "cases": rows, "argument_protocol": protocol, "negative_documents": negative,
        "limitations": "No throughput timings, repeated-file reuse checks, event equality, "
                       "file-specific conformance qualification, or assertion-enabled build. "
                       "Whole-process measurements will include one-time raw file reading, "
                       "backend/input setup, per-document reset and GC policy. Core reuses "
                       "its prepared codec for identical input references.",
    }
    (scratch / (args.implementation + "-smoke.json")).write_text(
        json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    if not (all(row["accepted"] for row in rows)
            and all(row["passed"] for row in protocol + negative)):
        raise SystemExit(1)
    print("Six acceptance checks, three CLI checks and two rejection checks passed.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare two native Eiffel benchmark executables using sequential AB/BA pairs."""

import argparse
import csv
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import io
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time


MAX_ITERATIONS = 2147483647
REPORT_NAMES = ("comparison.json", "comparison.tsv")
FIELDS = ("Workload", "Pair", "Order", "Iterations", "DocumentBytes",
          "BaselineElapsedMs", "CandidateElapsedMs", "BaselineMiBPerSecond",
          "CandidateMiBPerSecond", "CandidateSpeedRatio")


class BenchmarkError(RuntimeError):
    """A benchmark could not produce a trustworthy measurement."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Workload:
    name: str
    path: object
    document_bytes: int
    iterations: int


def positive_int(value):
    number = int(value)
    if not 1 <= number <= MAX_ITERATIONS:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError("must be between 1 and 2147483647")
    return number


def nonnegative_float(value):
    number = float(value)
    if not math.isfinite(number) or number < 0:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError("must be finite and nonnegative")
    return number


def parse_args(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--baseline", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--candidate", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path,
                        default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "build/eiffel-comparison")
    parser.add_argument("--workload", action="append", choices=("catalog", "text", "attributes", "files"))
    parser.add_argument("--xml-file", type=Path, action="append", default=[])
    parser.add_argument("--iterations", type=positive_int, default=10000)
    parser.add_argument("--file-iterations", type=positive_int, default=1000)
    parser.add_argument("--xml-iterations", type=positive_int, default=32)
    parser.add_argument("--pairs", type=positive_int, default=6)
    parser.add_argument("--warmups", type=positive_int, default=2)
    parser.add_argument("--min-sample-seconds", type=nonnegative_float, default=1.0)
    parser.add_argument("--timeout-seconds", type=positive_int,
                        help="Optional maximum duration of one benchmark process")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    for name in ("baseline", "candidate", "output_dir"):
        setattr(args, name, getattr(args, name).expanduser().resolve())
    args.xml_file = [path.expanduser().resolve() for path in args.xml_file]
    return args


def preflight_inputs(args):
    """Reject input/output aliases before invalidating reports or writing fixtures."""
    output = Path(args.output_dir).expanduser().resolve()
    reserved = [output / name for name in REPORT_NAMES]
    reserved += [output / "fixtures" / name for name in ("text.xml", "attributes.xml")]
    reserved = [path.resolve() for path in reserved]
    inputs = [("baseline", args.baseline), ("candidate", args.candidate)]
    inputs += [("XML input", path) for path in args.xml_file]
    for role, source in inputs:
        source = Path(source).expanduser().resolve()
        for destination in reserved:
            collision = source == destination
            if not collision:
                try:
                    collision = source.samefile(destination)
                except OSError:
                    # Missing or unreadable noncolliding inputs follow normal failure cleanup.
                    pass
            if collision:
                raise BenchmarkError("The {} {} aliases a reserved generated output {}. "
                                     "Choose a separate input or output directory.".format(
                                         role, source, destination))


def prepare_workloads(args):
    selected = list(dict.fromkeys(args.workload or
                    (["catalog", "text", "attributes"] + (["files"] if args.xml_file else []))))
    documents = {
        "text": "<root>" + "plain text " * 10000 + "</root>",
        "attributes": "<root>" + ("<item " + " ".join('a{:02d}="value"'.format(i)
                      for i in range(50)) + "/>") * 20 + "</root>",
    }
    workloads = []
    for name in selected:
        if name == "catalog":
            document = "<catalog>" + "".join('<item id="{}">value</item>'.format(i)
                       for i in range(1, 101)) + "</catalog>"
            workloads.append(Workload(name, None, len(document.encode("utf-8")), args.iterations))
        elif name in documents:
            path = args.output_dir / "fixtures" / (name + ".xml")
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            content = documents[name].encode("utf-8")
            path.write_bytes(content)
            workloads.append(Workload(name, path, len(content), args.file_iterations))
        else:
            if not args.xml_file:
                raise BenchmarkError("The files workload requires at least one --xml-file.")
            for index, path in enumerate(dict.fromkeys(args.xml_file), 1):
                workloads.append(Workload("file-{}:{}".format(index, path.name), path,
                                          path.stat().st_size, args.xml_iterations))
    return workloads


def run_sample(executable, iterations, workload, phase, output_dir, timeout=None):
    command = [str(executable), "--iterations", str(iterations)]
    if workload.path is not None:
        command += ["--file", str(workload.path)]
    work = output_dir / "work"
    work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    start = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        completed = subprocess.run(command, cwd=work, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                                   stderr=subprocess.PIPE, universal_newlines=True,
                                   encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=timeout)
        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
        expected = "xpact benchmark harness parsed {} documents.".format(iterations)
        if completed.returncode == 0 and completed.stdout.strip() == expected and elapsed > 0:
            return elapsed
        details = "exit={}\nstdout:\n{}\nstderr:\n{}".format(
            completed.returncode, completed.stdout, completed.stderr)
    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
        details = str(error)
    logs = output_dir / "logs"
    logs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    safe_phase = "".join(c if c.isalnum() or c in "-_." else "_" for c in phase)
    log = logs / (safe_phase + ".log")
    log.write_text(json.dumps(command) + "\n" + details, encoding="utf-8")
    raise BenchmarkError("Invalid benchmark result for {}. See {}".format(phase, log))


def clear_reports(output_dir):
    for name in REPORT_NAMES:
        path = output_dir / name
        if path.exists():
            path.unlink()


def publish_reports(output_dir, report):
    buffer = io.StringIO(newline="")
    writer = csv.DictWriter(buffer, fieldnames=FIELDS, delimiter="\t", lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(report["results"])
    contents = (json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", buffer.getvalue())
    staged = []
    try:
        for name, content in zip(REPORT_NAMES, contents):
            descriptor, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".comparison-", dir=str(output_dir))
            path = Path(temporary)
            staged.append((path, output_dir / name))
            with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
                stream.write(content)
        for temporary, destination in staged:
            temporary.replace(destination)
    except BaseException:
        clear_reports(output_dir)
        raise
    finally:
        for temporary, _ in staged:
            if temporary.exists():
                temporary.unlink()


def file_hash(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1048576), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def run_comparison(args):
    # This guard must remain outside cleanup: a colliding report may be the input itself.
    preflight_inputs(args)
    output = args.output_dir
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    clear_reports(output)
    try:
        executables = {"A": args.baseline, "B": args.candidate}
        identities = {role: {"path": str(path), "sha256": file_hash(path)}
                      for role, path in executables.items()}
        workloads = prepare_workloads(args)
        report = {"metadata": {"started_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                  "platform": platform.platform(), "python": platform.python_version(),
                  "executables": identities, "warmups": args.warmups, "pairs": args.pairs,
                  "min_sample_seconds": args.min_sample_seconds,
                  "method": "sequential native process wall time; alternating AB/BA pairs; speed ratio = baseline time / candidate time",
                  "workloads": [{"name": w.name, "path": str(w.path) if w.path else None,
                                 "document_bytes": w.document_bytes,
                                 "initial_iterations": w.iterations,
                                 "sha256": file_hash(w.path) if w.path else None} for w in workloads]},
                  "calibration": [], "results": [], "summary": []}
        for workload in workloads:
            count = workload.iterations
            print("Comparing {}...".format(workload.name), flush=True)
            def sample(role, phase):
                arguments = (executables[role], count, workload,
                             workload.name + "-" + phase + "-" + role, output)
                if args.timeout_seconds is not None:
                    return run_sample(*arguments, timeout=args.timeout_seconds)
                return run_sample(*arguments)
            if args.min_sample_seconds > 0:
                while True:
                    baseline, candidate = sample("A", "calibration"), sample("B", "calibration")
                    report["calibration"].append({"Workload": workload.name, "Iterations": count,
                        "BaselineElapsedMs": baseline * 1000, "CandidateElapsedMs": candidate * 1000})
                    if min(baseline, candidate) >= args.min_sample_seconds:
                        break
                    if count == MAX_ITERATIONS:
                        raise BenchmarkError("Cannot reach minimum sample time within the signed 32-bit iteration limit.")
                    count = min(count * 2, MAX_ITERATIONS)
            for warmup in range(args.warmups):
                for role in ("AB" if warmup % 2 == 0 else "BA"):
                    sample(role, "warmup-{}".format(warmup + 1))
            rows = []
            for pair in range(1, args.pairs + 1):
                order = "AB" if pair % 2 else "BA"
                elapsed = {role: sample(role, "pair-{}".format(pair)) for role in order}
                mib = count * workload.document_bytes / 1048576
                row = dict(zip(FIELDS, (workload.name, pair, order, count, workload.document_bytes,
                      elapsed["A"] * 1000, elapsed["B"] * 1000, mib / elapsed["A"],
                      mib / elapsed["B"], elapsed["A"] / elapsed["B"])))
                rows.append(row)
                report["results"].append(row)
                print("  pair {} {}: candidate speed ratio {:.4f}".format(pair, order, row["CandidateSpeedRatio"]), flush=True)
            ratios = [row["CandidateSpeedRatio"] for row in rows]
            report["summary"].append({"workload": workload.name, "pairs": len(rows), "iterations": count,
                "document_bytes": workload.document_bytes, "median_candidate_speed_ratio": statistics.median(ratios),
                "min_candidate_speed_ratio": min(ratios), "max_candidate_speed_ratio": max(ratios),
                "median_baseline_ms": statistics.median(row["BaselineElapsedMs"] for row in rows),
                "median_candidate_ms": statistics.median(row["CandidateElapsedMs"] for row in rows),
                "min_baseline_ms": min(row["BaselineElapsedMs"] for row in rows),
                "max_baseline_ms": max(row["BaselineElapsedMs"] for row in rows),
                "min_candidate_ms": min(row["CandidateElapsedMs"] for row in rows),
                "max_candidate_ms": max(row["CandidateElapsedMs"] for row in rows)})
        publish_reports(output, report)
        return report
    except BaseException:
        clear_reports(output)
        raise


def main(argv=None):
    try:
        run_comparison(parse_args(argv))
    except (BenchmarkError, OSError, ValueError) as error:
        print("Eiffel comparison failed: {}".format(error), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

class
	DC_CATALOG_ROOT

inherit
	XP_BUILD_IDENTITY
	DC_CATALOG_FIXTURE

create
	make

feature {NONE} -- Initialization

	make
		local
			arguments: ARGUMENTS_32
			iterations: INTEGER
		do
			create arguments
			if arguments.argument_count = 1 and then arguments.argument (1).same_string ("--identity") then
				put_identity
			elseif arguments.argument_count = 1 and then arguments.argument (1).same_string ("--qualify") then
				qualify
			elseif arguments.argument_count = 2 and then arguments.argument (1).same_string ("--iterations")
				and then arguments.argument (2).is_integer
			then
				iterations := arguments.argument (2).to_integer
				if iterations > 0 then
					benchmark (iterations)
				else
					usage_error
				end
			else
				usage_error
			end
		end

	put_identity
		local
			backend: DC_BACKEND
		do
			create backend.make (False)
			io.put_string ("XPACT_CATALOG_IDENTITY%T" + implementation_id + "%T" + source_revision + "%T" + build_configuration + "%T" + backend.gc_policy + "%N")
			backend.close
		end

	benchmark (iterations: INTEGER)
		local
			backend: DC_BACKEND
			i: INTEGER
			ok: BOOLEAN
		do
			create backend.make (False)
			from i := 0; ok := catalog.count = 2611 until i = iterations or not ok loop
				ok := backend.parse (catalog)
				if ok then i := i + 1 end
			end
			if ok and i = iterations then
				backend.close
				io.put_string ("xpact benchmark harness parsed " + i.out + " documents.%N")
			else
				io.error.put_string ("catalog benchmark failed after " + i.out + " documents: " + backend.last_error + "%N")
				backend.close
				exit_with_code (1)
			end
		end

feature {NONE} -- Untimed qualification

	qualify
		local
			ok, all_ok: BOOLEAN
		do
			put_identity
			ok := catalog_check (True)
			emit_case ("catalog_observed", ok, "2611 bytes; ordered root/item events, id=1..100 attributes and exact text value")
			all_ok := ok
			ok := catalog_check (False)
			emit_case ("catalog_noop", ok, "same catalog accepted through the timed no-op handler path")
			all_ok := all_ok and ok
			ok := reuse_check (True)
			emit_case ("observed_reuse_recovery", ok, "same parser: catalog twice, malformed, catalog, malformed; clean errors/events and closed references")
			all_ok := all_ok and ok
			ok := reuse_check (False)
			emit_case ("noop_reuse_recovery", ok, "same no-op parser: catalog twice, malformed, catalog, malformed; clean errors and closed references")
			all_ok := all_ok and ok
			ok := gc_check
			emit_case ("gc_restoration", ok, "incoming GC on/off restored after valid, mismatched and empty final inputs")
			all_ok := all_ok and ok
			if not all_ok then exit_with_code (1) end
		end

	catalog_check (observing: BOOLEAN): BOOLEAN
		local
			backend: DC_BACKEND
		do
			create backend.make (observing)
			Result := catalog.count = 2611 and then backend.parse (catalog) and then backend.last_error.is_empty
			if observing then
				Result := Result and backend.observer.trace.same_string (expected_trace)
			end
			if not Result then
				io.error.put_string ("catalog qualification: " + backend.last_error + "%N" + backend.observer.trace)
			end
			backend.close
			Result := Result and backend.is_closed and backend.observer.trace.is_empty
		end

	reuse_check (observing: BOOLEAN): BOOLEAN
		local
			backend: DC_BACKEND
			ok: BOOLEAN
		do
			create backend.make (observing)
			Result := backend.parse (catalog) and then backend.last_error.is_empty
			if observing then Result := Result and backend.observer.trace.same_string (expected_trace) end
			ok := backend.parse (catalog)
			Result := Result and ok and backend.last_error.is_empty
			if observing then Result := Result and backend.observer.trace.same_string (expected_trace) end
			ok := backend.parse (malformed)
			Result := Result and not ok and not backend.last_error.is_empty
			ok := backend.parse (catalog)
			Result := Result and ok and backend.last_error.is_empty
			if observing then Result := Result and backend.observer.trace.same_string (expected_trace) end
			ok := backend.parse (malformed)
			Result := Result and not ok and not backend.last_error.is_empty
			backend.close
			Result := Result and backend.is_closed and backend.observer.trace.is_empty
		end

	gc_check: BOOLEAN
		local
			memory: MEMORY
			backend: DC_BACKEND
			was_collecting, ignored: BOOLEAN
		do
			create memory
			was_collecting := memory.collecting
			create backend.make (False)
			memory.collection_on
			ignored := backend.parse (catalog)
			Result := ignored and memory.collecting
			ignored := backend.parse (malformed)
			Result := Result and not ignored and memory.collecting
			ignored := backend.parse ("")
			Result := Result and not ignored and memory.collecting
			memory.collection_off
			ignored := backend.parse (catalog)
			Result := Result and ignored and not memory.collecting
			ignored := backend.parse (malformed)
			Result := Result and not ignored and not memory.collecting
			ignored := backend.parse ("")
			Result := Result and not ignored and not memory.collecting
			backend.close
			Result := Result and backend.is_closed
			restore_gc (memory, was_collecting)
		rescue
			if memory /= Void then restore_gc (memory, was_collecting) end
		end

	restore_gc (memory: MEMORY; collecting: BOOLEAN)
		do
			if collecting then memory.collection_on else memory.collection_off end
		end

	emit_case (id: STRING_8; ok: BOOLEAN; detail: STRING_8)
		do
			io.put_string ("XPACT_CATALOG_CASE%T" + id + "%T")
			if ok then io.put_string ("PASS") else io.put_string ("FAIL") end
			io.put_string ("%T" + detail + "%N")
		end

	usage_error
		do
			io.error.put_string ("usage: --identity | --qualify | --iterations POSITIVE_INTEGER%N")
			exit_with_code (2)
		end

	exit_with_code (code: INTEGER)
		local
			exceptions: EXCEPTIONS
		do
			create exceptions
			exceptions.die (code)
		end

end
